div.head: Iud Dei VIII Inscr.
div.ab: Beschwöre man den [zum Abendmahl vor dem Kaltwasser-Ordal tretenden] Menschen hier.
Let one here adjure the person [coming to communion before the cold-water ordeal].
div.note: U: translator unrecorded: check; MS Ca (Cambridge, Corpus Christi College 422, p. 330, after Iud Dei I 22.5). Liebermann dates it c. 950–1050; the language is late West Saxon, and irregularities may be the scribe's. ‘ðonne’ stands for ‘ðone’.; F: added from Liebermann, Gesetze I (date in the running heads), October 2026 (Suggested dates: Liebermann’s date credited or added, and Wormald’s where the database had none from him; the same change in all 8 rows of Iud Dei VIII); F: corrected against Liebermann, Gesetze I (date at the head of the text); Wormald, Making of English Law I; Whitelock, English Historical Documents I, October 2026 (was “c.950–1050 (Liebermann)”, now “c.950–1050 (Liebermann, I p. 415)”); BQ: page of each of Liebermann’s texts and of his German, checked against Liebermann, Gesetze I (our double-read transcription), October 2026 (e.g. was “(empty)”, now “Ca 415; German 415”; 8 rows of Iud Dei VIII)
